historicalWindow.note: The NVIDIA event predates the installation window; it does not establish causality.

desktopRefreshProbe.note: One desktop association-refresh notification; not a full installation reproduction. A negative probe does not rule out an intermittent GPU or I/O stall.

reinstall.userObservation: User did not notice whether the freeze recurred

limitations: The five-minute ETW limit caused tracing to wind down during installation; final completion-page coverage is incomplete.
No DPC events were available in the filtered installation window; zero reported DPC duration must not be interpreted as zero driver latency.
CPU process-name attribution was incomplete; no process or driver is assigned as the cause.

conclusion: No confirmed causal finding. Disk latency in the captured portion and the standalone refresh probe did not demonstrate a multi-second system stall. A complete trace spanning a confirmed recurrence is still needed.
privacy: Raw ETL, application names and file activity are not included in the repository.

diagnosticTool.behavior: Opt-in: sends one desktop association-refresh notification; prints JSON to stdout without overwriting historical evidence. Removes its unique native build directory on success or failure.
diagnosticTool.scope: A two-second sampling phase before and after the notification; shell response and scheduling measurements only. Does not measure full installation or establish the cause of an intermittent freeze.
